svg.title: Aegis: one loop, every belief graded
svg.desc: The Aegis loop, nine stages on a ring: 1 world sensors (news_pull · web_reader); 2 evidence (world_digest · data_catalog); 3 world state / theory (world_state · hyp_theory_cells); 4 forecasts (belief_state · forecast_ledger); 5 decision (opportunity_funnel · decision_contract); 6 paper action (sim_session · task_keeper); 7 outcome (daily_pass · forecast_grader); 8 attribution (book_dna · regret_ledger); 9 learning (policy_state · hyp_lab). A wave travels the ring and dwells at each stage while it lights; learning feeds the next cycle's theory and decision through two inner orbits.
svg.text: Writes down what it believes before the outcome exists, grades every belief,
and lets only graded beliefs change how paper capital is sized.
An LLM reads what was stored and
risk priced on what it would buy
Paper only, and a HOLD is a decision.
No LLM has authority over real capital
A daily pass grades what came due
and reports refusals, never hides them
Which input did it, and when did we
EVERY STAGE NAMES THE CODE THAT RUNS IT
